readout: The locked film and post are factually disciplined, culturally respectful, and ready for the scorer panel. They identify Tanana Chiefs Conference and Sully.ai, present the useful clerical case plainly, and keep every important boundary intact. Permission precedes recording. Provider review precedes chart entry. The ninety-day policy stays attached to recordings. Possible reuse is limited to de-identified portions. HIPAA language and continued care are attributed to TCC rather than presented as independent findings. The unknown retention period is asked as a question, not framed as evidence of wrongdoing. No invented patient experience, real patient depiction, medical outcome, deployment count, privacy failure, physical product interface, or separate reuse opt-out is asserted. I found no hard-blocking typo, copy error, attribution error, or culturally inappropriate visual in the reviewed R4 evidence.

authority_applied.dispatch_rules: The Dispatch-specific hook, length, punctuation and hashtag rules supersede the weekly Facebook post rules in brand.yaml.

copy_readout.post_gate: PASS with zero failures or warnings; 2.95 commas per 100 words.
copy_readout.argument: A useful documentation tool and genuine patient choice can coexist. The post credits the announced benefit without converting an aim into a result.
copy_readout.question: The closing question asks what readers would need to know before consenting to this specific kind of note taker.
copy_readout.visible_copy: Reviewed all 44 built caption cues and the current beat labels and credits. Dates in spoken prose use the required month-first or spoken-ordinal form. On-screen dates are provenance stamps. No banned dash, colon, semicolon, formal-register contraction error, visible pronunciation spelling, or hard-blocking typo was found.

factual_integrity.finding: The film says TCC is introducing Sully.ai and calls reduced typing and increased attention an aim. It expressly says this notice reports no measured benefit.
Permission comes before recording. The provider reviews, edits and approves the note before chart entry, and Sully.ai is not described as making medical decisions.

factual_integrity.boundary: Recording, chart note and reused portions
factual_integrity.finding: The three artifacts remain distinct. The ninety-day policy applies only to recordings, while reuse is conditional and limited to de-identified portions. No retention period for those portions is invented.
Both are explicitly attributed to TCC and visually labeled as stated terms rather than an audit or observed patient outcome.

The concrete instruction is to tell the provider. The later lever and recorder are unmistakably marked as an illustration of TCC's terms, not a claimed Sully.ai interface or patient-operated clinical device.

cultural_respect.finding: The piece names TCC as an Interior Alaska tribal health organization without borrowing Indigenous symbols, staging ceremony, exoticizing communities, or using patients or tribal culture as a gag. Generic figures illustrate roles and terms; they are not presented as actual patients, named people, or testimony. The editorial critique stays on documentation, consent and evidence status.
